cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_sdl3_mesh_fixture C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "This private fault-injection fixture requires Linux linker wrapping")
endif()
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_REQUIRE_NATIVE ON CACHE BOOL "SDL mesh fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_executable(test_sdl3_mesh "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_sdl3_mesh.c")
target_link_libraries(test_sdl3_mesh PRIVATE cui_sdl3 cui_software ${CUI_SDL_TARGET})
cui_warnings(test_sdl3_mesh)
foreach(symbol SDL_CreateRenderer SDL_RenderPresent SDL_CreateTextureFromSurface SDL_DestroyTexture SDL_SetTextureScaleMode SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom SDL_SetTextureBlendMode SDL_SetRenderScale SDL_RenderTexture calloc)
 target_link_options(test_sdl3_mesh PRIVATE "-Wl,--wrap=${symbol}")
endforeach()
if(NOT CUI_TEST_FONT)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Mesh mixed-text fixture requires an existing font")
endif()
add_test(NAME sdl3_mesh COMMAND test_sdl3_mesh "${CUI_TEST_FONT}")
set_tests_properties(sdl3_mesh PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=software")
add_executable(test_mesh_cpu "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_mesh_cpu.c")
target_link_libraries(test_mesh_cpu PRIVATE cui_software cui)
cui_warnings(test_mesh_cpu)
add_test(NAME mesh_cpu COMMAND test_mesh_cpu)
